touches.text: These files live in cairn/devices/cairn/requirements/, one per section, and TOC.md names each. They are the map of the system; there is no other. Git keeps every version.

An artifact is present tense or past tense, never both. Present tense is rewritten whole and points at its provenance; past tense is append-only, opened when needed, and read cold only through a compiled face (state, the latest slate). WHY: what a cold reader loads at an address should be what is true now.
Code that is no longer needed is deleted. Git history keeps it if we ever need it back.

The plan is <id>-<slug>.json: current, one-line outcomes and constraints. The history is <id>.log.jsonl, append-only. Questions live in questions/. A big decision goes in these files; a small one on the ticket.

Ticket or task is decided at /intent by the seed test: would replaying it on a bare machine help regrow the system? Then it is a ticket, the default. A task that finds a rule spawns a ticket for the rule, and a task that recurs is the signal to write a ticket that automates it.

Each stage moves from the model to deterministic code once a proof a hollow build could not pass can hold it; hypothesize stays with the model longest. Validate sends a local miss back to hypothesize and a structural one back to design. A build that finds new work spawns children that enter at decompose.
A proof that cannot go red without its build (its hollow is empty) stands only on Akien's answered approval, recorded as the hollow reading and re-read at clearance; any other empty hollow is red.
A green no one vouched for still completes, and notifies the operator with the file, the diff and the rate.

CLAUDE.md is the first file every CC session reads: the Laws, pointers into these files, and the rules still awaiting physics, each with its ticket. About 2k tokens, and challenged at every addition. WHY: it loads into every turn, so every word costs every session.
The first miss of a datum is a learning signal, folded into the report; the same gap recurring is the defect.
One verb, qualified by its target: build (the scans), session (the slate), debug (diagnostic_inspector).
THE ROOTS: what everything traces up to
